name: excited
title: Excited
description: High energy, fast, bright; for hype moments and big reveals.
instruct: Speak with high energy and genuine excitement, fast, bright and enthusiastic.
sample: No way. No way! It actually worked on the first try? [laugh] Do you understand how rare that is? I've been fighting this bug for three days and it just... compiled. Clean. Zero warnings. I might frame this terminal.
